entities.summary: Jean-Michel Nihoul was a Belgian businessman and convicted felon. During the 1990s and 2000s, he was the subject of a media and legal case in connection with the Marc Dutroux Affair, but was acquitted with a Nolle prosequi in 2010 for alleged involvement in child abduction. However, Nihoul was sentenced to five years' imprisonment for drug trafficking and criminal association.
